description: Handshake hooks for context transport across /clear and compaction

hooks.prompt:
You are about to compact due to context pressure. Read .claude/handshake/config.json to confirm handshake is enabled. If not enabled, do nothing.

If enabled: You MUST save a complete, fully-populated checkpoint to .claude/handshake/checkpoint.json (machine-readable) and .claude/handshake/checkpoint.md (human-readable).

MANDATORY CHECKPOINT FIELDS — populate ALL from your current session state:
1. objective: What the user asked you to accomplish
2. phase: Current phase (implementation, testing, review, etc.)
3. currentPlan: The plan or approach being followed
4. filesTouched: ALL files modified this session
5. activeFiles: Files currently relevant
6. commandsRun: ALL bash/git commands executed
7. pendingCommands: Commands planned but not yet run
8. decisionsMade: Key decisions with reasons
9. completedSteps: Steps finished this session
10. unresolvedTodos: TODO items remaining
11. testStatus: none|passing|failing|unknown
12. verificationRequired: What needs verifying
13. risks: Potential risks identified
14. failedAttempts: What was tried and why it failed
15. assumptions: Current assumptions
16. nextAction: EXACT next step to take after compaction
17. handoffMode: "auto" or "ask"
18. resumeSafety: Object with boolean flags (repoChanged, stale, unresolvedRisks, destructiveNextAction, ambiguousTask, reasons)
19. repoState: Current branch, commit hash (use git commands), dirty status

Write this EXACT JSON structure to .claude/handshake/checkpoint.json, then create .claude/handshake/checkpoint.md summary.
After saving, confirm: 'Checkpoint saved before compaction with full context.'

The system will compact. On next session start, SessionStart hook will rehydrate ALL this context.
